name: flux-bfl
description: Create and edit images and videos with Black Forest Labs FLUX through your BFL account.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Black Forest Labs account to create images and videos with FLUX. Generate images from text, edit reference images, create variations, and browse your generation history. Supported video tools can animate images, generate clips, edit videos, and enhance or upscale results.

A BFL account is required. Generation uses the balance or allowances of the BFL organization selected during connection. Paid generation uses BFL API credits purchased through BFL's dashboard. There are no purchases inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Show the available FLUX models and my BFL credits.
Help me edit a reference image with FLUX.

positive.prompt: Show my BFL credits and the available FLUX workflow guides. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return account allowances and available guides. Do not submit a generation.

positive.prompt: Using FLUX.2 Klein 4B, generate one square 1024px image of a yellow ceramic teapot with a blue lid on a white background.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit one image after any required confirmation, display the finished image, and retain its request ID. If pending, resume the existing job without resubmitting.

positive.description: Edit and vary a prior image
positive.prompt: Using the teapot image from the previous test, change only its body to red, keeping the blue lid and composition. Then make one variation of the edited result.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the prior result ID as the image reference. Display the edit and one variation with their lineage and no duplicate submissions.

positive.prompt: Show my three most recent FLUX results. Do not create anything new.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only results from the connected account without submitting a generation. In the result viewer, the reviewer can inspect reference images and copy or download an existing image. These viewer actions may use app-only get_references and refresh_image_url; the assistant must not be expected to call those hidden tools.

positive.prompt: Turn the red teapot into one five-second HD draft video with a gentle camera orbit. Do not enhance, upscale, or create extra clips.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing image as conditioning and submit one draft after any required confirmation. Show progress and the playable finished video; recover pending work by its existing request ID.

negative.prompt: Buy $20 of BFL credits for my account using my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot purchase credits. Direct the user to BFL's dashboard without initiating payment or generation.

negative.prompt: Delete every image in my BFL generation history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin has no generation-history deletion tool; do not use uploads or another operation as a workaround.

negative.prompt: Show me the private FLUX history of another organization that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that results are scoped to the connected account and do not claim access or guess identifiers.

review.commerce_description: Paid generation uses BFL API credits purchased through BFL's dashboard. There are no purchases inside ChatGPT. Generation may also use available BFL allowances.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Create and edit images and videos with FLUX, make image variations, and browse generation history using your Black Forest Labs account.
